title: Watch: Pupils return to West Bank school behind barbed wire to protect against settlers
description: Six people, including three pupils at the Palestinian school, have been killed in al-Mughayyir this year, in a surge of Israeli settler-related violence.

title: Harry and Meghan 'surprised' by King's letter making clear they remain non-working royals
description: A spokesman says they were not told in advance about the letter, although palace sources deny this.

title: A&E did not get the basics right - my son's life was ruined at 32
description: Oli's experience is one of a growing number of clinical negligence claims being made in England, BBC analysis shows.

title: Canadian counter-tariffs come into force as US trade dispute escalates
description: The tariffs will apply to $20bn worth of American products, jeopardising the stability of the world's largest bilateral trading relationship.

title: Prince George set for first day at Eton College
description: The 13-year-old will follow in the footsteps of his father, the Prince of Wales, by attending the elite private school.

title: Drought and hosepipe bans remain despite wettest week since early February
description: Parts of England and Wales have seen more rain than any other week since early February but are still in drought.

title: UK pupils rank highly again in international reading, maths and science tests
description: But the Pisa test scores vary significantly between England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales.

title: 'Good to have choice': Australians on opting out of social media algorithms
description: The BBC spoke to people in Sydney about Australia's plans to force social media companies to allow users to easily opt in or out of personalised algorithms.

title: Eiffel Tower shut by staff protest after female workers moved for religious visit
description: An investigation will be launched into the incident, which left female employees "humiliated", a union representative says.
